up: For the document with CHEMBL ID 'CHEMBL3044971', retrieve the ChEMBL ID (chembl_id), compound name, and canonical SMILES for distinct molecules. Only include rows where canonical SMILES are available (not null). Order the results by chembl_id, then compound name, then canonical SMILES.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, cr.compound_name, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3044971' AND cs.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL ORDER BY md.chembl_id, cr.compound_name, cs.canonical_smiles;
